Intro.title: Building the Future of Medical Education
Intro.body: ASCEL provides an environment where medical professionals and learners can develop practical skills through simulation, experimental learning, education, and collaboration. The center is being established in Gyumri to address gaps in hands-on training and to support a regional culture of professional medical education.

AboutPage.title: A center for simulation, education, and professional practice
AboutPage.whoBody: The Armenian Simulation Center for Experimental Learning (ASCEL) is being established in Gyumri as a medical simulation center for experimental learning. It is intended to address critical gaps in practical skills training for healthcare professionals and to serve as a regional hub for medical education.
AboutPage.missionBody: To provide a professional environment where physicians and medical learners can develop practical skills through simulation-based education, experimental learning, and international collaboration.
AboutPage.visionBody: To help Armenia become a regional center for advanced medical education and simulation-based professional training — serious, international in standard, and grounded in practical competence.
AboutPage.whatBody: ASCEL brings together medical education, simulation-based training, practical learning, and related programs. Active directions currently include Gyumri Orthopedic School, Damage Control Courses, and a partnership presentation of Eternal Nation Foundation — each distinct, presented under one institutional platform.
AboutPage.simulationBody: Simulation allows teams to rehearse procedures, communication, and decision-making in a controlled setting. Intended methods include high-fidelity mannequins, virtual reality, robotics, and other experimental learning approaches described in public project materials.
AboutPage.experimentalBody: Experimental learning at ASCEL refers to structured, hands-on methods that go beyond lecture: skills laboratories, scenario-based teaching, and, where appropriate and ethically governed, advanced simulation techniques used in medical education internationally.
AboutPage.developmentBody: The center is conceived as a setting for continuing education — courses, workshops, and collaborative teaching that help physicians and related professionals strengthen practical competence.
AboutPage.collaborationBody: ASCEL is designed to work with faculty and partners from Armenia and abroad. Confirmed institutional partnerships will be listed when they are authorized for publication.
AboutPage.approachBody: The design of the center is educational first: clear programs, practical training, and a calm professional environment. Programs remain distinguishable. Independent partner organizations are not presented as the same legal entity as ASCEL.
AboutPage.timelineItem1Body: ASCEL was presented as a healthcare education project focused on establishing a medical simulation center in Gyumri, including as a featured project at AMWC 2025.
